name: UniZulu Engineering Chatbot
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python scripts/build_knowledge.py && (pip install -r requirements-llm.txt --extra-index-url https://abetlen.github.io/llama-cpp-python/whl/cpu || echo 'Language-model extras not installed: the chatbot still works without them.')
postAttachCommand: USE_LLM=1 streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
